name: undeclared-ruling-not-in-context
invariant: An undeclared ruling never enters a review's controller context: the review that owes a ruling, once it is answered, still renders only its declared inputs (empty/completed_clean); a round 2 recorded with an answer to an owed input no ancestor asked for is refused by the evaluator (failed/lineage_undeclared); the successor that declares the answer its predecessor owed renders it and is re-keyed (found/review_input_changed) (13 "Successor rounds"; 10; 11:156).
